Question: In triangle \(ABC,\) \(\angle C=\theta\) and \(\angle B=2\theta,\) where \(0^\circ\lt\theta\lt60^\circ.\) The circle with center \(A\) and radius \(AB\) intersects \(AC\) at \(D\) and intersects \(BC,\) extended if necessary, at \(B\) and at \(E\) (\(E\) may coincide with \(B\)). Then \(EC=AD\)
